title: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
sub: Get them talking about the guide. If they're open to more, invite them to your Facebook group.
tracksQuestion: What did this lead just do?

tracks.label: They downloaded the guide
tracks.hint: Most of your leads. They opted in for the recipe guide and that is all you know about them so far.

steps.title: Text them the same day
steps.lead: Send this soon after they opt in, while the guide is still open on their phone:
script: Hey [Name], this is [Your Name]! I made the Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide you just got in your email, let me know if you have any questions!
Which lunch are you trying first?
steps.copyLabel: Copy the text for a lead who downloaded the guide

steps.title: If they don't answer
steps.lead: Give it two days. Most people mean to reply and then their week starts:
script: Hey [Name], did you get a chance to look at the guide? Let me know which one you try first.
steps.copyLabel: Copy the two day follow-up nudge

steps.title: Once they're talking, invite them to your group
steps.lead: Only if they're open to it. Skip this if you don't run or belong to a group:
script: I also run a Facebook group that is a support system for people who are using holistic methods to improve their life. Would love to have you there! [your Facebook group link]
When it asks who invited you, just put [Your Name] so I know to let you in!

tracks.label: They asked for the supplement guide
tracks.hint: They tapped for the free supplement guide and the Glutathione+ info, on the thank-you page or in their email. You get a text the moment it happens.

steps.title: Send it while they're still on their phone
steps.lead: Tap the link in your alert. Their page in the app has your reply ready to send.
script: Hey [Name], this is [Your Name]! Here's the supplement guide you asked for, plus the info on Glutathione+. Which goal is the big one for you right now?
steps.copyLabel: Copy the text for a lead who asked for the supplement guide

steps.title: Once they're talking, invite them to your group
steps.lead: Only if they're open to it:
script: I also run a Facebook group where we talk through this stuff every day. Would love to have you there! [your Facebook group link]
When it asks who invited you, just put [Your Name] so I know to let you in!
steps.copyLabel: Copy the group invite for a lead who asked for the supplement guide

steps.title: Approve them and welcome them by name
steps.lead: Approve them the same day. Facebook asks new members who invited them, so your name will be on their request. Then post this in the group:
script: Welcome [Name]! 👋 Tell us a bit about yourself and what you are working on right now, we all started somewhere.
Anyone here dealing with the same thing, jump in and say hi.

steps.title: Check in a few days later
steps.lead: Five to seven days after they join. Ask about the guide, not about the group:
script: Hey [Name]! Did you get a chance to try anything out of the recipe guide yet?
Tell me the honest answer, good or bad. It helps me know what to put in the next one.

tip: Tip: Send your own group link, never anyone else's. Paste it into the group invite once, save it in your phone, and every lead after that is a two second reply. Approve member requests daily: somebody who asked to join on Tuesday and got let in on Saturday has already forgotten who you are.
